; The semantic control for inlined-calls: @f is written identically to
; inline-a.ll, character for character. Only the callee's body differs. If the
; expansion is not really pulling the callee in, @f fingerprints the same here
; as in inline-a.ll and the normalisation is decorative.
define internal i32 @g(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %d = mul i32 %v, 4
  %e = add i32 %d, 5
  ret i32 %e
}

define i32 @f(i32 %x) {
entry:
  %r = call i32 @g(i32 %x)
  %s = add i32 %r, 1
  ret i32 %s
}
